prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for adoption, redesign, finish, new_screen, and new_flow changes, as no kind of change has at least 2 agreeing tests yet.
No kind of change has been shown to be helpful yet, as all tests so far resulted in no clear effect.
Predictions were overall too high, particularly for redesigns (predicted +12.0%, measured -3.4%) and new flows (predicted +2.0%, measured -4.6%).

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, redesign: -1.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_flow: -2.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: +1.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, hint] Custom Pet Photo Tips Banner: Add photo submission guidance text to the photo upload screen explaining optimal photo lighting and angles. (why: 3 support tickets noted custom pet creation failures or visual glitches during photo generation.)
1: [sign_in, hint] Account Persistence Notice: Display a clear hint on the sign-in screen reassuring users that signing in saves pet progress safely. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or resetting after signing in again.)
2: [home, wait_info] Creation Wait Progress Details: Show time estimate and notification option while waiting for the pet to load. (why: The home step waiting period has a long median time of 201s and mean of 2336s.)
3: [finish, copy] Desktop Controls Quick Tip: Add concise instructions on the home intro screen explaining desktop pet positioning and right-click menus. (why: 3 support emails reported confusion about how to control, hide, or interact with their pet after onboarding.)
4: [choose_path, layout] Path Choice Two Column Layout: Change the path selection screen layout to two-column to make comparing pet adoption options easier. (why: High mean time (514s) on choose_path suggests decision hesitation when choosing a path.)
5: [sign_in, layout] Sign-In Compact Layout: Switch the sign-in screen to a compact layout to reduce visual friction and potential screen stalls. (why: Sign-in drops 27.1% of users and some report screen stalling issues before sign-in.)

scores.note: Adoption drops 39.1% and 3 tickets support guidance; copy change is low-cost but unproven.
Sign-in drops 27.1% and 8 support emails strongly align; simple text change with good potential.
Funnel shows extreme wait times (2336s mean), but lack of support emails limits evidence.
Finish loses 35.2% and 3 emails report confusion; previous finish tests showed mixed/flat results.
High mean time indicates hesitation, but layout/redesign changes have performed poorly historically.
Addresses sign-in drop and stalling reports, but layout changes carry poor historical confidence.
